implementation.algorithm: control/current_feedback_filter.h：固定系数两轴一阶低通，0旁路、1直通；首有效输入初始化，非有限输入/历史失败清输出。
implementation.ownership: 算法持有数值状态，ControlRuntime在唯一同步边界更新，并在Stop/故障/再次Start时reset。
implementation.placement: CurrentMeasurement原始校正相值先做有效性/新鲜度/过流检查，随后alpha/beta控制输入支路低通，再进入原CurrentController。
implementation.publication: RUN Id/Iq与PI采用同一滤后DQ；IDLE/Stop仍发布未滤波观测DQ。MotorSnapshot和线上对象布局不变。
implementation.cost: 逐拍有限两轴加权及合法性检查，无窗口循环、统计、动态分配、RTOS调用或阻塞；实际CPU时序仍待同镜像实机验证。
implementation.safety: Hardware Trip、TIM6独立守卫、软件safe-off、0.65名义A原始相电流阈值、1.8V请求/300rpm/2圈/MCU1.5秒均保持。

startup binds, arms and starts timing once while power remains disabled
each startup dependency/arm failure, bad timing fact and dirty trip fails closed
only complete requests cross to Motor at a sample boundary
Stop overtakes and retires old queued motion, overflow and later requests
one-slot overflow reports rejection on the owner without replacing a pending request
malformed, NUL, long and UART-error lines discard through LF then recover
100ms fragment timeout never promotes a tail command or releases error-line discard
no-TXE service never waits; 44-byte telemetry keeps unimplemented channels invalid
bus publication failure, stale/future timestamp and invalid voltage stay invalid
sample faults use authoritative evidence, latch, safe-off and survive Stop/Clear
TIM6 safe-offs without ADC, hides old telemetry and ADC later incorporates fault
ADC preemption after DWT reads preserves cadence and healthy telemetry validity
independent periodic observations establish signed velocity across either zero crossing
duplicate timestamps preserve velocity and a later observation uses its actual capture interval
unavailable publication retains fresh cache, expires after 5 ms and requires two new samples to recover
invalid acquisition/reference/value and stale/future/backward timestamps discard history before rebuilding
valid velocity does not permit Start or power; unincorporated guard evidence invalidates every telemetry field
velocity validity changes publish naturally at acquisition, 5 ms expiry and signed recovery without commands
invalid observation immediately withdraws published velocity and two new samples restore it without commands
an in-flight frame completes consistently and the next frame reflects feedback expiry without a command
bus validity publishes on acquisition, 5 ms expiry, recovery and invalid capture without commands
